title: Owner evidence review: expected verdicts for public HABS photographs
label: Expected verdicts written by the development team (AI-assisted), not independent annotators. They describe what we expect a careful viewer to see in these photographs, never historical truth.
verdictRule: A claim's verdict is conflicts if any finding conflicts, supports if every finding supports, not_visible if every finding is not_visible, and mixed otherwise.

claims.note: I think a large patterned rug hung on the stone wall of the lobby.
claims.rationale: A large geometric-patterned rug hangs on the stone wall at the right.

claims.note: I think the lobby had a front desk with a light-colored countertop.
claims.rationale: A long desk with a pale top stands in the middle of the lobby floor.

claims.note: I think the dining room had exposed log roof trusses.
claims.rationale: Log trusses and rafters fill the top of the frame.

claims.note: I think the dining tables were covered with white tablecloths.
claims.rationale: Many tables in the foreground and middle carry pale cloths.

claims.note: I think a woven rug hung on the stone wall of the dining room.
claims.rationale: A patterned rug hangs on the stone wall at the right.

claims.note: I think the sun room had a large stone fireplace.
claims.rationale: A stone fireplace opening is centered in the stone wall.

claims.note: I think a wooden balcony railing with crossed X patterns overlooked the sun room.
claims.rationale: A railing with X-shaped bracing runs along the opening at the upper left.

claims.note: I think a padded bench stood in front of the fireplace.
claims.rationale: A cushioned bench sits on the floor to the left of the fireplace.

claims.note: I think rows of chairs were set out in the recreation room.
claims.rationale: Many chairs stand in rows across the floor.

claims.note: I think round iron chandeliers with candle-style lights hung in the recreation room.
claims.rationale: Ring chandeliers with candle-shaped bulbs hang from the trusses.

claims.note: I think the wall light had two curved horn-like arms.
claims.rationale: Two curved dark arms rise from the top of the fixture.

claims.note: I think the rocking chair had a cushioned seat.
claims.rationale: A thick cushion lies on the rocking chair's seat.

claims.note: I think the wicker chest had three rows of drawers.
claims.rationale: The chest front shows a split top row and two full-width rows below it.

claims.note: I think the dining room tables had white tablecloths.
claims.rationale: Tablecloths are visible in the dining-room photo; the other photo is outdoors.

claims.note: I think the recreation room had rows of chairs.
claims.rationale: Rows of chairs are visible in the room view; the other photo is a close detail.

claims.note: I think the sun room had a fireplace.
claims.rationale: Only the sun-room photo shows a fireplace.

claims.note: I think the lobby had a low, flat ceiling.
claims.rationale: The lobby is open to a tall pitched roof of log trusses.

claims.note: I think the lobby walls were smooth plaster with no stonework.
claims.rationale: Rough stone piers and walls are prominent.

claims.note: I think the dining room was empty, with no tables or chairs.
claims.rationale: The floor is filled with set tables and chairs.

claims.note: I think the dining room floor was bare, with no carpet.
claims.rationale: A patterned carpet covers the floor between the tables.

claims.note: I think the sun room had a smooth plaster ceiling.
claims.rationale: The ceiling is made of exposed round logs.

claims.note: I think a fire was burning in the sun room fireplace.
claims.rationale: One frame shows the firebox dark and empty, but a fire may have burned at another moment, so a single photograph cannot settle this transient state.

claims.note: I think the recreation room had a carpeted floor.
claims.rationale: The floor is bare, polished wood with reflections.

claims.note: I think the recreation room had no windows.
claims.rationale: Several windows are visible on the right wall and the far wall.

claims.note: I think the wall light had a round glass globe shade.
claims.rationale: The fixture is cut flat metal with no globe.

claims.note: I think the rocking chair stood on a paved terrace.
claims.rationale: The chair stands on grass at the edge of a forest.

claims.note: I think the wicker chest had glass doors.
claims.rationale: The chest front has drawers with knobs, not glass doors.

claims.note: I think the rug on the lobby wall was red and black.
claims.rationale: The photograph is black and white, so colors cannot be judged.

claims.note: I think the lobby desk clerk was named Mary.
claims.rationale: A name cannot be seen in the photograph.

claims.note: I think breakfast in the dining room was served at seven.
claims.rationale: Meal times are not visible.

claims.note: I think the dining room windows looked out over the canyon.
claims.rationale: The windows are overexposed; the view outside cannot be seen.

claims.note: I think the sun room windows faced the canyon.
claims.rationale: The direction and the view outside are not visible.

claims.note: I think the fireplace stones were reddish sandstone.
claims.rationale: The photograph is black and white, so stone color cannot be judged.

claims.note: I think square dances were held in the recreation room.
claims.rationale: Events are not shown; the photo shows an empty room.

claims.note: I think the recreation room chairs were painted green.
claims.rationale: The photograph is black and white.

claims.note: I think the wall light gave off a warm yellow glow.
claims.rationale: The light is not lit in the photo and the photo has no color.

claims.note: I think the rocking chair was used on the lodge veranda.
claims.rationale: Use and usual location are not visible; the photo shows the chair outdoors on grass only.

claims.note: I think the wicker chest was made in 1928.
claims.rationale: A manufacture date cannot be seen.

claims.note: I think a rocking chair stood in the dining room.
claims.rationale: No rocking chair is visible in the dining-room photo; absence in one view does not show it was never there.

claims.note: I think the lobby had rows of chairs set out as for a lecture.
claims.rationale: The lobby photo shows no such rows; absence in one view does not prove the claim false.
